edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Personal Space for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 — he is a stationary battery while it is down; step up only on its downtime. - Singularity is 12s and executes below a threshold — leave its pull early. - Budget W (16s) for emergencies, R for opportunities.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: His only dash is Astral Flight — when he flies in or out it feeds your mark, and your next Q through it becomes a guaranteed fear.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Singularity deals percent-health and executes below a threshold — poking low inside its pull hands him a kill your bar said was safe.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — mark-and-bolt every wave contact; the fear windows zone harder than the damage.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — shove him under tower and poke every Breath of Light channel to starve stacks.

edits.before: Shadow Surge online — any skirmish in missile range is now your business; the reset execute travels.
edits.after: Shadow Surge beats his weak pre-stack R — all-in and the fear cancels his Astral Flight escape.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the full marked rotation chunks half bars and fears the answer. Force the gloom war.
edits.after: Luden's arrives before his stacks matter — the full rotation chunks half bars while he still farms.

edits.before: Late Vex is anti-engage incarnate: their dive feeds your fears, your R feeds on their deaths.
edits.after: Catch him with Astral Flight down and he is a stationary battery — Shadow Surge deletes him.
